post.description: Return the full estimated number of recoverable sessions and the configured maximum per batch. The estimate is not capped at that maximum. This endpoint does not create a recovery request. Narrow the query or time range if the estimate exceeds max_recoverable_sessions. Creation checks a fresh estimate and returns 400 if it exceeds the configured maximum.

above_maximum.summary: An estimate of 150,000 exceeds the batch maximum

post.description:
Start targeted or query-based batch recovery. Use the returned `data.id` to poll the recovery request for progress. Batch creation checks a fresh recoverable-session estimate against the configured maximum (100,000 by default), accepting estimates equal to the maximum. Use the count operation to check the current maximum; creation can still reject a changed estimate. Narrow the query or time range if the maximum is exceeded.

Creation is not idempotent. After an uncertain response, check session search or batch listing before retrying.

limit_exceeded.summary: The server estimate exceeds the configured batch maximum

errors.detail: Estimated recoverable sessions exceed the batch maximum. Narrow the query or time range.

get.description: Get progress for a targeted or batch recovery request. A `COMPLETED` request can include failed sessions; check individual session statuses for targeted recovery.

post.description: Search archived RUM sessions. Use `meta.page.next_cursor` to retrieve the next page.

Approve or deny the submitted terms, which are immutable. Approval atomically writes the grant, audit record, and request decision. An expired request can't be approved. Requires the Billing Edit permission. Requires an authenticated human user. Service-account credentials aren't supported. Request status remains approved after the grant's expiry, revocation, or replacement.

tags.description:
Search archived RUM sessions and recover individual sessions or query-based batches. Your organization must have Managed Archives enabled. Creating, counting, listing, and canceling batches also require batch recovery enablement.

Requires `rum_rehydration_filter_read` for search and request details, or `rum_rehydration_index` to create, estimate recoverable sessions, list batches, or cancel recovery requests.
tags.name: RUM Recovery

tags.description:
The usage metering API allows you to get hourly, daily, and
monthly usage across multiple facets of Datadog.
This API is available to all Pro and Enterprise customers.

**Note**: Usage data is delayed by up to 72 hours from when it was incurred.
It is retained for 15 months.

You can retrieve up to 24 hours of hourly usage data for multiple organizations,
and up to two months of hourly usage data for a single organization in one request.
Learn more on the [usage details documentation](https://docs.datadoghq.com/account_management/billing/usage_details/).
tags.name: Usage Metering
